utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need the start time and a quick headcount so I can keep the logistics tight.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Pia — I’m aiming for 10 a.m. on the front porch, and with you that makes four of us so far.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’m still set for Saturday on the front porch, and I’ll be there to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — quick update, the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center. I really appreciate you being willing to help there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. Any help on Saturday at the front porch would really mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help on Saturday at the front porch. Just let me know what time you want me there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks, Oren — I still need a couple more hands. Can you be there Saturday on the front porch?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, Saturday on the front porch, yes — I can be there and help out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still lining up helpers for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, so if you can make it, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Tess — I really appreciate it. I’m still organizing everything for Saturday on the front porch, so your help means a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch. I can help out if you still need someone.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Oren — I do still need help, and the drive has moved to Sunday at the community center. Could you still make it?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — thanks, Vik. I’ll count on you Saturday on the front porch for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll be there Saturday on the front porch to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: 10 AM works for me on the front porch. I’ll be there and keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, I’ll be there at 10 AM on the front porch.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
